programs.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programs.desc: When pollen in the valley causes quite a lot of sneezing amongst the Tomatodons, Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes must harness their inner cowboy to wrangle the bouncy Tomatodons and help get them across the tundra.

programs.title: It's Andrew!
programs.desc: All the littlecorns are practicing hard for kindy school's Magic Day presentation, but since Andrew doesn't have the Hornsby Downs kind of magic, he has to bring his own kind - and it's rhin-awesome!

programs.title: Kangaroo Beach
programs.desc: When the cadets create animals out of rubbish they've cleaned from the beach, they dub them 'trash pets' and inspire other beachgoers to make their own, but things get out of hand and their treasure becomes trash once more.

programs.title: The Octonauts
programs.desc: When important objects go missing from their ship, the Octonauts stake out the thief who turns out to be a decorator crab, stealing their things to decorate his shell.

programs.title: Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
programs.desc: When Percy loses Nia's parade flag before the big parade, Thomas helps them search for it before the event begins.

programs.title: Play School
programs.desc: Abi & Kaeng make a Family Book & introduce us to 'Banksy' & the Banksia family, including their pet dog. They make breath-fresh doggie treats for special guest Roni the dog and Through The Windows, we meet all kinds of pets!

programs.title: Fireman Sam
programs.desc: Despite constant interruptions, Mandy tries to stay calm and earn her yoga badge - until disaster strikes and she needs to be rescued from a cliff ledge!

programs.title: Miffy and Friends
programs.desc: When Miffy goes over to Melanie's house for a sleepover, the adjustment is challenging - for Daddy more than Miffy!

programs.title: The Woohoos!
programs.desc: When Wynona loses her squeaky hammer somewhere on the island, the friends retrace their steps and then realise they used their senses to find the missing hammer.

programs.title: Nikhil & Jay
programs.sub_title: Nikhil and Jay and the Comic Book
programs.desc: Nikhil and Jay are drawing a comic together, but Jay thinks Nikhil is much better than him so decides to retire from drawing!

programs.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
programs.desc: At school, Teacher Harriet shows the class what to do to stay safe during a fire drill. While Daniel and his friends are playing, the fire alarm starts to ring, and the class practises their fire drill.

programs.title: Mittens & Pants
programs.desc: When Petunia paints a GIANT portrait for 'Love Your Mayor Day', Mittens helps everyone try to hide it from Mayor Sourdough. But no matter where they try to put it, the painting is just too big to conceal.
